itemOffers.description: A smooth warm-grey stone birdbath with still jade water and one carved woodland bird. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
a basic bench, allows weary travelers to find rest in your garden
A curved charcoal-iron lamppost with softly glowing amber panes. Static, cosmetic decoration; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A faded blanket, a well-loved basket, and two mugs waiting for their owners. A little rest leaves room for another adventure.

gardenSkills.name: Second Wind
gardenSkills.description: +5% water from active energy while placed.

items.description: A crooked wooden sign with Home, Somewhere and a scratched-out third direction. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A midnight-blue garden gnome etched with stars and nebulae. Celestial Welcome gives +4.5% garden attraction while placed.

gardenSkills.name: Celestial Welcome
gardenSkills.description: +4.5% garden attraction while placed.

items.description: A shell-roof woodland mailbox with leaf letters and a waiting parcel. +5% offline visitor storage capacity while placed.

gardenSkills.description: +5% offline visitor storage capacity while placed.

items.description: A reel-tethered kite holds a tiny floating cloud. Gentle six-second wind loop. Gentle Hold extends butterfly welcome time by 20% while placed.

gardenSkills.name: Gentle Hold
gardenSkills.description: +20% butterfly welcome time while placed.

items.description: A slumped scarecrow beneath an oversized straw hat, with one bird nesting in its pocket. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A smooth warm-grey stone birdbath with still jade water and one carved woodland bird. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A curved wooden harp with seven sky-reflecting droplets. Morning Rain gives each planted plant +2.5 water at the start of each game day.

gardenSkills.name: Morning Rain
gardenSkills.description: +2.5 water per planted plant at account-local midnight. Rainharp and plant must be placed at reset. Duplicate harps apply once.

items.description: A fungal switchboard with seed-husk receivers and traveling light pulses. Sporeline Surge gives all planted plants +4% water from workouts while placed.

gardenSkills.name: Sporeline Surge
gardenSkills.description: +4% water from supported workouts while placed.

items.description: A rounded straw hive on a wooden stand, with a honey pot and drinking saucer. +3% garden attraction while placed. Gentle honey drip.

gardenSkills.name: Pollinator's Welcome
gardenSkills.description: +3% garden attraction while placed.

items.description: A three-tined iron pitchfork with a honey-wood handle and tan wrapped grip. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A warm clay kiln with flickering green foxfire and three unfinished acorn cups on its drying shelf. Cosmetic; no gameplay skill.
A hollow-log lending library with bark-bound books and a full-moon return sign. Borrowed Wisdom gives +1% activity water per distinct planted species, capped at +5%.

gardenSkills.name: Borrowed Wisdom
gardenSkills.description: +1% activity water per distinct planted species, up to +5%.
